description: This file contains mock setup code for testing various components of a larger system, specifically mocking modules using Vitest. It defines mock implementations for numerous modules related to system diagnostics and configuration, such as doctor-completion, doctor-bootstrap-size, doctor-browser, etc.

methods.name: vi.mock
methods.description: Mocks an external module, providing a factory that returns mock implementations for specified functions.

methods.name: vi.fn
methods.description: Creates a mock function which can be used to track calls and set return values.
